column5: GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 9. `CO:204` if the descriptor catalog graph fails to build, sources and effects stay empty and `validate_compatibility` returns `Ok` on empty requirements (`CO:716`). Wrong program: "a function for which the descriptor catalog graph fails to build would produce no loans from stored call effects, so those conflicts would not be reported".
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 10. `CO:553-562` `access_location` falls back to the longest known prefix path, including the empty path.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 11. `CO:1069-1073` for return operations the moved list is emptied. Wrong program: "a return that moves a place still backing a live loan".
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 12. `CO:1160`, `CO:1276` `zip` of bindings with destination parameters truncates; extra bindings are never checked as disturbed.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 13. `CO:1620-1623` an edge whose target is missing or empty is dropped from the ordering graph; the analysis could "believe fewer paths exist".

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 14. `CO:2207-2211` a binding into an exclusive-borrow parameter whose source has no contract or is not `Owned` skips the owner-liveness checks.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 16. `CO:2467`, `2554`, `2589` same `zip` truncation in edge transfer; the final count check covers only claims.
